visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, chestnut-colored hair and glasses perched on her head stands in what appears to be a modern shopping mall or retail environment. She is wearing a white T-shirt featuring a pink cartoon bear graphic and blue denim jeans. She holds a gold-colored iPhone toward the camera, smiling with a friendly expression. (2) Close-up shots of the iPhone 16 Pro in 'Desert Titanium' are shown, revealing the triple-lens camera system and its sleek, metallic finish. The woman's hands, with manicured nails and gold jewelry, are seen holding and wiping the device with a small white cloth. (3) The scene shifts to an automated recycling kiosk labeled 'BUNNIT.' The machine is white with a large touch screen and a blue digital rabbit logo. The woman interacts with the screen, which displays various prompts in Traditional Chinese. (4) A brief shot shows a queue of people standing in a hallway near a line of gachapon machines, suggesting a busy public space. (5) A series of close-up shots follow the process of preparing the phone: removing the SIM card, taking off the screen protector, and connecting it to the kiosk's internal cables. The woman's hands are shown performing these delicate tasks. (6) The final phase shows the woman standing next to the kiosk, which displays the valuation result of '24,713.' She speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial gestures, including pointing to the screen and later to the phone, concluding with a heart gesture.

A sharp 'ding' SFX marks the appearance of text. (2) A fast 'whoosh' transition sound occurs as the camera zooms into the phone. The female voice continues with high pitch variability, explaining the phone's condition. (3) As the Bunnit machine is introduced, a series of 'pop' and 'beep' digital UI sound effects punctuate the explanation of the machine's benefits. (4) During the tutorial section, rhythmic 'chime' sounds trigger with each new instructional text box. The BGM remains consistent in the background. (5) A series of metallic 'click' and 'slide' SFX are heard, simulating the physical actions of removing the SIM card and screen protector, synchronized with the visuals. (6) A festive 'fanfare' or sparkling stinger sound plays when the final price is revealed. The voice adopts a slightly more contemplative tone while discussing the trade-off between cash and vouchers, ending with an upbeat inquiry to the audience.
